rationale: Ground truth is essentially a clean LGTM plus one already-resolved suggestion (move helpers to utils/, done in this diff), so recall is near-trivial and ties. Both candidates independently found the same two most important issues (the identical unfixed race in diffusion_engine.py's busy loop, and that 2 of the 3 new regression tests don't actually gate the reverted-fix regression), but Y's treatment is deeper and more rigorous (traces cancel call sites, checks pytest/pyproject threadexception behavior to prove the tests pass under CI config even reverted, offers exact assert-level fixes) while X pads its output with four near-duplicate 'claim-refuted' entries about the same PR-description typo, hurting signal-to-noise. Y also surfaces a genuinely novel, well-grounded finding (the abort-path _completed_outputs leak never evicted on shutdown) that X misses entirely, and its 'Change:' blocks with concrete code are more directly actionable than X's evidence-dump style.
